# Astronomical v0.2.105
### New - A link can now open Astronomical on one model: `astronomical://models/huggingface/OWNER/NAME`. It shows Observatory's Models page with that model at the top and its own Get button. Nothing downloads until you press Get, and only models from Astronomical's checked list are offered.
### Improved - Developer builds: when Apple refuses a notarization check, the release tool now shows Apple's own reply.
### Compatibility - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. - Your settings, downloaded models, conversations and prompt cache are kept. - The app and its disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
